title: Pick-up and the daily report
setting: Talking with parents · Primrose Lane Nursery

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Hi! You must be Sara — Vida says you're brilliant. How was William today?

translations.fa: سلام! تو باید سارا باشی — ویدا میگه فوق‌العاده‌ای. ویلیام امروز چطور بود؟

branches.suggestion: Hi, Leslie! He had a great day.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام لزلی! روز خیلی خوبی داشت.

cultureNote.en: A daily report covers food, sleep, nappies/toilet, activities and anything special. Keep it positive and factual.
cultureNote.fa: گزارش روزانه: غذا، خواب، دستشویی، فعالیت‌ها.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Lovely! Did he eat his lunch? He's been fussy at home this week.

translations.fa: چه خوب! ناهارش را خورد؟ این هفته تو خونه بدغذایی می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: Yes, he ate all of it and had seconds!
branches.suggestionFa: آره، همه‌ش را خورد و دوباره هم گرفت!

branches.suggestion: He ate most of his lunch, but no peas.
branches.suggestionFa: بیشتر ناهارش را خورد، ولی نخود نه.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Ha, typical! And did he have a nap?

branches.suggestion: Yes, he slept for an hour, from one to two.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، یه ساعت خوابید، از یک تا دو.

branches.suggestion: Yes, he slept really well after lunch.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، بعد از ناهار خیلی خوب خوابید.

recasts.echo: He slept for an hour? Great.

n4.speaker: william
n4.text: Mummy! I made a rocket! A big one!

translations.fa: مامان! یه موشک ساختم! یه بزرگش!

branches.suggestion: He made it from boxes this morning.

branches.suggestionFa: موشکت را به مامان نشون بده ویلیام!

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: I came too! Can I see the rocket? Why is it green?

translations.fa: منم اومدم! می‌تونم موشک را ببینم؟ چرا سبزه؟

branches.suggestionFa: چون ویلیام سبز را انتخاب کرد!

branches.suggestion: Hi, Nicola! He painted it himself.

cultureNote.en: Older siblings often come along at pick-up. Greet them too — it helps the younger child feel proud.
cultureNote.fa: خواهر و برادرهای بزرگ‌تر هم موقع تحویل عصر میان؛ به اونا هم سلام کن.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Wow, it's brilliant! Any toilet accidents today?

branches.suggestion: No accidents — he told us every time.
branches.suggestionFa: هیچ خیس‌کاری‌ای — هر بار بهمون گفت.

branches.suggestion: Just one, before lunch. His wet clothes are in his bag.
branches.suggestionFa: فقط یه بار، قبل از ناهار. لباس‌های خیسش تو کیفشه.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Fantastic. Thanks, Sara. You sound like a real nursery practitioner already!

translations.fa: فوق‌العاده. ممنون سارا. همین الان مثل یه مربی مهد واقعی حرف می‌زنی!
